description: Pydantic schemas for test run API requests and responses, defining data models for test execution and logging.

classes.name: RunBase
classes.description: Base schema for test run, including optional identifiers and grouping info.

classes.name: RunCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new test run, extending RunBase with variables.

classes.name: RunTestCaseRequest
classes.description: Schema for running a specific test case, including test case ID and optional variables.

classes.name: RunQueueExecuteRequest
classes.description: Schema for batch execution request, including run configuration and test file/test case IDs.

classes.name: RunResponse
classes.description: Schema for test run response, including status, timestamps, paths, and error info.

classes.name: RunLogsResponse
classes.description: Schema for run logs response, including log content and presigned URLs.
